title: At school and university
about: School subjects like maths, history and PE, things you find in a classroom, and phrases for school and university: teach, study, take and pass an exam, do homework.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Домашнє завдання — do homework, не make homework. Homework незлічуване: не homeworks і не a homework, а a lot of homework. Українські «вчити» і «складати іспит» мають кілька англійських відповідників: вчити когось — teach, вчити щось самому — learn / study; складати іспит — take / do an exam, а скласти успішно — pass. Дивись таблицю.

rows: We've got a lot of homework.
We've got a lot of homeworks.
He goes to university. / He's at university.
Give me a piece of paper.

items.pattern: English · in English · an English lesson / teacher
items.meaning: the language: its words, grammar, reading and writing
items.example: We have **English** three times a week.
more: We had a spelling test in **English** today.
My **English** teacher gives us ten new words every week.
items.watchOut: English завжди пишуть з великої літери. Англійською — in English (не on English): Say it in English.

items.pattern: maths is … · a maths lesson / teacher
items.meaning: working with numbers: adding, taking away and more
items.example: I find **maths** easy, but my brother finds it hard.
more: We need a calculator for **maths** tomorrow.
Our **maths** teacher always draws funny shapes on the board.
items.watchOut: Maths — британське слово, американці кажуть math. Хоч слово закінчується на -s, воно в однині: Maths is my favourite subject (не are).

items.pattern: history · a history lesson · the history of sth
items.meaning: what happened in the past, long ago
items.example: In **history** we're learning about ancient Egypt.
more: My grandad loves **history** and reads about old castles.
We visited a museum with our **history** teacher.
items.watchOut: Українське «історія» — це і history (минуле, предмет), і story (розповідь, казка). Розкажи мені історію — tell me a story, а не a history.

items.pattern: geography · a geography lesson
items.meaning: countries, cities, rivers, mountains and maps
items.example: In **geography** we learnt about the weather in different countries.
more: I like **geography** because I love maps.
Our **geography** teacher has been to twenty countries.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: ge-O-graphy /dʒiˈɒɡrəfi/.

items.pattern: biology · a biology lesson
items.meaning: living things: plants, animals and the human body
items.example: In **biology** we looked at a leaf under a microscope.
more: My sister wants to be a vet, so she loves **biology**.
Today in **biology** we learnt how fish breathe.
items.watchOut: Bi- читається як «бай», наголос на другому складі: /baɪˈɒlədʒi/.

items.pattern: art · an art lesson / teacher
items.meaning: drawing, painting and making pictures
items.example: We painted pictures of autumn trees in **art** today.
more: **Art** is my favourite subject. I love painting.
Our **art** teacher put our pictures on the wall.
items.watchOut: Урок малювання — an art lesson, зазвичай не a drawing lesson. Art — це і малювання, і живопис, і ліплення.

items.pattern: ICT · an ICT lesson
items.meaning: lessons where you learn to use computers
items.example: In **ICT** we learnt how to send an email.
more: **ICT** is easy for me because I use a computer at home.
Our **ICT** teacher helped me make a birthday card on the computer.
items.watchOut: ICT — information and communication technology. Кажуть по літерах: /ˌaɪ siː ˈtiː/. Зараз в англійських школах цей предмет частіше називають computing.

items.pattern: PE · a PE lesson · PE kit
items.meaning: sport and exercise lessons at school
items.example: Don't forget your trainers. We've got **PE** after lunch.
more: We do **PE** in the big gym next to the library.
My favourite part of **PE** is running races.
items.watchOut: PE — physical education, кажуть по літерах: /ˌpiː ˈiː/. Не physical culture.

items.pattern: chemistry · a chemistry lesson
items.meaning: what things are made of and how they change when you mix them
items.example: Our **chemistry** teacher showed us how to make a small volcano.
more: My brother wants to study **chemistry** at university.
We always wear safety glasses in **chemistry**.
items.watchOut: Ch тут читається як [k]: /ˈkemɪstri/ — «кемістрі», не «чемістрі».

items.pattern: modern languages · learn a language
items.meaning: languages people speak today, like French, German or Spanish
items.example: At my new school, **modern languages** are my favourite lessons.
more: In **modern languages** I'm learning Spanish.
My dad teaches **modern languages** at a school in Odesa.
items.watchOut: Modern тут — «сучасні»: мови, якими говорять сьогодні, на відміну від латини. Кажуть також foreign languages.

items.pattern: physics is … · a physics lesson
items.meaning: light, electricity, heat and how things move
items.example: In **physics** we made a small light work with a battery.
more: **Physics** is hard, but I like the experiments.
In **physics** we learnt why ice melts in the sun.
items.watchOut: Як і maths, physics закінчується на -s, але це однина: Physics is difficult. Фізик (людина) — physicist.

items.pattern: music · a music lesson · play / listen to music
items.meaning: singing, playing instruments and listening to songs
items.example: In **music** we're learning a new song for the school concert.
more: I play the guitar in **music** lessons.
Our **music** teacher can play five instruments.
items.watchOut: Music незлічуване: some music, a piece of music, а не a music чи musics.

items.pattern: the board · on the board · a whiteboard
items.meaning: a big flat thing on the wall; the teacher writes on it
items.example: Look at the **board**, please. Can you read the question?
more: Can you come to the **whiteboard** and draw a triangle?
I can't see the **board** from the back of the class.
items.watchOut: Писати на дошці — write on the board. Вийти до дошки — come to the board. Не плутай board (дошка) і desk (парта).

items.pattern: a noticeboard · on the noticeboard
items.meaning: a board on the wall where people put papers with information
items.example: There's a new poster about the school disco on the **noticeboard**.
more: Our class photo is on the **noticeboard** next to the door.
Is there anything new on the **noticeboard** today?
items.watchOut: Американською — bulletin board.

items.pattern: a piece of paper · two pieces of paper
items.meaning: one sheet of paper
items.example: Write your name on a **piece of paper** and give it to me.
more: I folded a **piece of paper** and made a little boat.
Can I have two **pieces of paper**, please?
items.watchOut: Paper (папір) незлічуване: зазвичай не a paper і не two papers, а a piece of paper / a sheet of paper. A paper — це газета. «Лист паперу» — не a leaf of paper.

items.pattern: a pencil · in pencil · sharpen a pencil
items.meaning: a thing for writing and drawing; you can rub out what you write
items.example: I always draw with a soft **pencil**.
more: My little brother drew a horse with a green **pencil**.
Can I borrow a **pencil**? Mine is broken.
items.watchOut: Олівцем — in pencil (без a), ручкою — in pen: Write it in pencil.

items.pattern: a notebook · write in a notebook
items.meaning: a small book with empty pages for writing
items.example: My new **notebook** has a cat on the cover.
more: She keeps a **notebook** by her bed for her ideas.
I've filled my maths **notebook** already!
items.watchOut: Notebook — зошит чи блокнот, а textbook — підручник. Не плутай їх.

items.pattern: a textbook · open your textbook at page …
items.meaning: a book you learn from at school, with texts and exercises
items.example: We need a new **textbook** for maths this year.
more: My **textbook** is really heavy, and my bag hurts my back.
The answers are at the back of the **textbook**.
items.watchOut: «Відкрийте на сторінці 20» — open your books at page 20 (брит.) або to page 20 (амер.). Але «вправа на сторінці 20» — the exercise is on page 20.

items.pattern: a drawing pin · put sth up with a drawing pin
items.meaning: a short pin with a flat top; you push it into a board
items.example: Can you pass me a **drawing pin**? I want to put up this photo.
more: We need more **drawing pins** for the noticeboard.
These **drawing pins** have red and yellow tops.
items.watchOut: Канцелярська кнопка — drawing pin (американською thumbtack). Не button: button — це ґудзик або кнопка на пристрої.

items.pattern: an OHP · an overhead projector
items.meaning: a machine that shows a big picture on the wall or a screen
items.example: The **OHP** in our classroom is old, but it still works.
more: Can you turn off the **overhead projector**, please? The lesson is over.
The teacher showed us a map with the **OHP**.
items.watchOut: OHP читається по літерах: /ˌəʊ eɪtʃ ˈpiː/. Перед ним an, бо перший звук голосний: an OHP, an overhead projector.

items.pattern: a rubber · rub sth out with a rubber
items.meaning: a small thing for taking away pencil marks
items.example: My **rubber** smells of strawberries.
more: Rub it out with a **rubber** and try again.
I've lost my **rubber** again!
items.watchOut: Rubber — британське слово. Американці кажуть eraser, і в США краще казати саме так. Стерти гумкою — rub out.

items.pattern: a pen · in pen · write with a pen
items.meaning: a thing for writing with ink
items.example: Can I borrow your **pen**? I want to write my name on this card.
more: Dad gave me a blue **pen** for my birthday.
I always carry a **pen** in my bag.
items.watchOut: Ручка для письма — pen. Handle — це ручка дверей, сумки чи чашки.

items.pattern: a pencil sharpener · sharpen a pencil
items.meaning: a small thing that makes a pencil sharp
items.example: There's a little **pencil sharpener** in my pencil case.
more: My **pencil sharpener** looks like a small car.
Please empty the **pencil sharpener** into the bin.

items.pattern: a board rubber · clean the board with a board rubber
items.meaning: a thing for cleaning the board
items.example: The **board rubber** is on the shelf under the whiteboard.
more: Our **board rubber** is old and leaves blue lines.
It's my job to look after the **board rubber** this week.
items.watchOut: Американською — eraser, як і звичайна гумка.

items.pattern: a board pen · write with a board pen
items.meaning: a thick pen for writing on a whiteboard
items.example: This **board pen** is dry. Have you got a new one?
more: The teacher has **board pens** in four colours.
Put the lid back on the **board pen**, or it will dry.
items.watchOut: Маркер для дошки ще називають board marker або whiteboard marker.

items.pattern: a DVD player · watch a film on a DVD player
items.meaning: a machine for watching films on discs
items.example: Our grandparents still watch films on their **DVD player**.
more: Our school **DVD player** is in the music room.
My uncle has more than 200 films for his **DVD player**.

items.pattern: a desk · sit at a desk · at your desk
items.meaning: a table where you sit to write or study
items.example: I share a **desk** with my best friend.
more: My **desk** at home is next to the window.
Please don't write on your **desk**!
items.watchOut: Desk — це не дошка (board), а парта чи письмовий стіл. Сидіти за партою — sit at a desk.

items.pattern: a ruler · draw a line with a ruler
items.meaning: a long flat thing for drawing straight lines and measuring
items.example: My **ruler** is 30 centimetres long.
more: Can I borrow your **ruler**? I need to draw a box.
This **ruler** has a picture of a dinosaur on it.
items.watchOut: Ruler означає ще й «правитель» (король чи королева).

items.pattern: a computer · on the computer
items.meaning: a machine for writing, looking for information, games and more
items.example: I did my geography project on the **computer**.
more: Our **computer** is old and very slow.
My brother is always playing games on the **computer**.
items.watchOut: На комп'ютері — on the computer, не in the computer.

items.pattern: teach sb sth · teach sb to do sth · teach – taught – taught · a teacher
items.meaning: help someone to learn something; give lessons
items.example: My mum is a teacher. She **teaches** art at a primary school.
more: Who **taught** you to ride a bike?
Mr Wood **taught** us about the planets.
items.watchOut: «Вчити» буває двох видів. Вчити когось — teach: She teaches me English. Вчити щось самому — learn або study: I learn English. Не She learns me.

items.pattern: study sth · study at school / university · study for a test · a student
items.meaning: learn about a subject, usually at school or university
items.example: My big sister **studies** music in Lviv.
more: My dad **studied** maths when he was young.
Do you **study** at the weekend?
items.watchOut: Learn — коли вчишся щось робити (learn to swim) або запам'ятовуєш (learn new words). Study — коли вивчаєш предмет, часто в школі чи університеті: study history.

items.pattern: go to school · go to university (no the)
items.meaning: be a pupil at a school or a student at a university
items.uk: ходити до школи; навчатися в університеті
items.example: I **go to school** five days a week.
more: My brother **goes to university** in Kharkiv.
My cousin **went to university** in Lviv.
items.watchOut: Коли ти там навчаєшся, кажуть без the: go to school, go to university. З the — коли йдеш до будівлі з іншою метою: Mum went to the school to see my teacher.

items.pattern: learn to + verb · learn – learnt / learned
items.meaning: start to be able to read and write
items.example: My little brother is **learning to read and write** this year.
more: I **learnt to read and write** in Ukrainian first, and then in English.
She **learnt to read** with picture books about animals.
items.watchOut: Після learn ставлять to + дієслово: learn to read, learn to swim. Не learn read.

items.pattern: do a course · do an English / a cooking course
items.meaning: go to lessons to learn something, for a few weeks or months
items.example: My grandma **is doing a painting course** at the art centre.
more: I'd like to **do a dance course** next year.
My dad **did a cooking course**, and now he makes great pizza.
items.watchOut: «Ходити на курси», «пройти курс» — do a course (або take a course), в однині. Pass a course — це успішно закінчити курс, а не ходити на нього; не кажи I'm passing English courses.

items.pattern: take / do an exam · take / do a test
items.meaning: answer questions to show what you know
items.example: Older students **take exams** at the end of the school year.
more: My cousin is **doing her exams** this month, so she's very busy.
I'm nervous. I'm **doing my piano exam** tomorrow.
items.watchOut: Головна пастка: «складати іспит» — take / do an exam. Pass an exam — це вже скласти успішно. I'm passing an exam tomorrow звучить так, ніби ти вже знаєш результат.

items.pattern: pass an exam / a test
items.meaning: get a good enough result in an exam
items.example: Great news! I **passed the exam**!
more: My mum **passed** her driving test on her first try.
You need 60 points to **pass** this test.
items.watchOut: Pass — коли результат успішний: I passed! I hope I pass. Сам процес — take / do an exam: I'm taking an exam tomorrow.

items.pattern: fail an exam / a test
items.meaning: not get a good enough result in an exam
items.example: Sadly, my brother **failed** his driving test.
more: Nobody in our class **failed** the spelling test.
I was afraid to **fail**, but I got 90 points!
items.watchOut: Провалити іспит — fail an exam, без прийменника. Не failed on the exam.

items.pattern: get a degree · a degree in biology
items.meaning: finish university successfully and get a document about it
items.example: My uncle **got a degree** in physics in Poland.
more: You need **a degree** to be a doctor.
She wants to **get a degree** in art.
items.watchOut: Диплом університету — a degree. Diploma — частіше документ після коротшого курсу чи коледжу. Ступінь з якогось предмета — a degree in sth (in, не of).

items.pattern: do (your) homework · a lot of homework
items.meaning: do school work at home
items.example: I always **do my homework** before I play outside.
more: My dad helps me when I **do my homework**.
Our teacher gives us **homework** every day.
items.watchOut: Do homework, а не make homework. Homework незлічуване: не homeworks і не a homework. Багато завдань — a lot of homework.

warmup.uk: Завтра я складаю іспит з англійської.
warmup.explain: Складати іспит — take (або do) an exam. Pass — скласти успішно, коли результат уже відомий.
Домашнє завдання робимо з do: do homework — done.

warmup.q: My dad is ___ me to swim.
warmup.explain: Вчити когось — teach. Learn — вчитися самому: I'm learning to swim.
Скласти іспит успішно — pass an exam.

warmup.uk: Дай мені, будь ласка, аркуш паперу.
warmup.q: Can you give me a ___? I want to write a note.
warmup.explain: Аркуш паперу — a piece of paper. A paper — це газета.

warmup.uk: Влітку я ходитиму на курси англійської.
warmup.q: In the summer I'm going to ___ an English course.
warmup.explain: Ходити на курси — do a course, в однині.
Навчатися в університеті — go to university, без the.

warmup.q: Open your ___ at page ten and read the text about castles.

A.q: Our ___ teacher always wears a tracksuit and trainers.
We need an atlas with maps for ___ today.
In ___ we listened to songs from different countries.

B.q: Put the poster on the wall with a ___.
My ___ is so small now that I can't hold it to rub out my mistakes.
We read the stories in our English ___ and do the exercises after them.
B.explain: Підручник з текстами і вправами — textbook. Notebook — зошит із чистими сторінками.

C.explain: Вчити когось — teach. Learn і study — вчитися самому.

C.q: Ben got only 20 points out of 100. He ___ the test.
Our teacher says we must ___ our homework in pen.
C.explain: Домашнє завдання — do homework, не make.

example.title: A busy Monday
example.uk:
У понеділок вранці я поїхала до школи автобусом. Першим уроком була математика. Учителька написала на дошці довгий приклад, і я переписала його в зошит.

Потім у нас була фізкультура. Ми грали у футбол під дощем!

Після обіду ми писали коротку контрольну з історії. Я хвилювалася, але склала її.

Увечері я зробила домашнє завдання за своїм письмовим столом. Потім мама навчила мене грати нову пісню на гітарі. Це був насичений, але щасливий день.
example.en:
On Monday morning I [[went to school|c3]] by bus. Our first lesson was [[maths|a2]]. The teacher wrote a long sum on the [[board|b1]], and I copied it into my [[notebook|b5]].

Then we had [[PE|a8]]. We played football in the rain!

After lunch we [[took|c6]] a short [[history|a3]] test. I was nervous, but I [[passed|c7]].

In the evening I [[did my homework|c10]] at my [[desk|b15]]. Then my mum [[taught|c1]] me to play a new song on the guitar. It was a busy but happy day.
